## Research claim and source-provenance audit

- [ ] Every original-paper claim uses a named source/version and is listed in the evidence registry if a page, table, theorem or equation must be verified.
- [ ] Each citation link is explicitly a bibliographic landing page, indexed text, or **tested downloadable PDF**, with no mislabeling.
- [ ] For literal equations or page-number claims: actual PDF bytes, hash, rendered page image and human comparison are documented; otherwise marked **PENDING / indexed text only**.
- [ ] All paper and implementation claims correctly distinguish reproduced source equations from proposed approximations.
- [ ] Source-provenance CI and negative regression tests passed; no unsupported source verification claims.
- [ ] Python numerical tests and economic equilibrium conditions were run separately from document/PDF build.
- [ ] Any unfinished general equilibrium, failed solver or source inaccessibility is prominently disclosed.
